name: echolon
description: A powerful, local-first API client - Postman alternative
author: Echolon Team

scripts.build: ENV=prod npm run build:vite && npm run build:electron
scripts.release:
SECONDS=0; source .env.production && npm run build && electron-builder --publish always; printf 'Done in %dm %ds
' $((SECONDS/60)) $((SECONDS%60))
scripts.release:mac:
SECONDS=0; npm run build && export $(cat .env.production | xargs) && echo GH_TOKEN is: ${GH_TOKEN:0:10}... && electron-builder --mac --publish always; printf 'Done in %dm %ds
' $((SECONDS/60)) $((SECONDS%60))
scripts.release:mac:fast: npm run build && export $(cat .env.production | xargs) && electron-builder --mac zip --arm64 --publish always -c.compression=store
scripts.release:win:
SECONDS=0; npm run build && export $(cat .env.production | xargs) && electron-builder --win --publish always; printf 'Done in %dm %ds
' $((SECONDS/60)) $((SECONDS%60))
scripts.release:linux:
SECONDS=0; npm run build && export $(cat .env.production | xargs) && electron-builder --linux --publish always; printf 'Done in %dm %ds
' $((SECONDS/60)) $((SECONDS%60))
scripts.release:all:
SECONDS=0; npm run build && npm run release:mac && npm run release:win && npm run release:linux; printf 'Done in %dm %ds
' $((SECONDS/60)) $((SECONDS%60))
